description:
CzyJestEldorado is a job search engine focused exclusively on the Polish IT market. This connector gives AI agents direct access to our job listings database, updated in real time. We index the largest IT job portals in Poland, and additionally monitor employer ATS systems, company websites, and government organizations — so the database also includes listings unavailable anywhere else.

Offers can be filtered by work mode (remote, hybrid, onsite), contract type, salary range, technology stack, seniority level, location, and publication date, with support for excluding specific keywords or companies.

defaultPrompt: Znajdź oferty pracy dla programisty Pythona zdalnie z pensją powyżej 15 000 zł
